why: The owner calls Accordee's shell "mit oben den Tabs [...] oben rechts auch noch die Controls" better than ours. There every list page has the same single row. We spread the job over three places: segment tabs in the PageBar band (src/page/page-tabs.tsx), saved views in a toolbar popover (src/table/parts/views.tsx) and FilterSet pills. Accordee refactored 16 list pages onto one ToolbarTabs component before it could lint the pattern.
what: PageBar, its tabs, ViewTabs, and the summary strip of a fill page.
owns: generated docs and the page reference of the basalt-design skill through its generator
must_not_touch: packages/basalt-ui/src/table/** (bench-manage-view binds saved views to the tabs)
change: Read first: docs/v3/issues/bench/README.md (owner direction, decisions, how to use the reference) and docs/v3/BENCHMARK-ACCORDEE-BLUEPRINT.md. (1) PageBar gains the view row as the grammar of a list page: on the left a tab list where each tab is a named view or a named filter with an optional count and tone dot; on the right, in this order, an inline search, a filter trigger that shows the number of active filters, a layout toggle, a view-settings trigger, secondary actions and at most one primary. One line at the bar height, a hairline below, no fill. It folds by the existing tiers: labels become icons, tabs scroll, the rest goes to the "more" menu; on a phone the search takes its own row. (2) Tabs variant for the row: a quiet pill for the active tab, count in muted tabular figures, a red or toned count allowed for an attention tab. The tab still binds a ControlHandle. (3) The filter trigger opens the FilterSet as a popover of grouped chip sets and checkbox lists with a live "showing N of M" and a reset; pills in the bar stay available where a page has two filters or fewer. Decide the threshold in the Spec. (4) A fill page may put a flush summary strip under the view row: StatGroup cells divided by hairlines, each with label, value, a sub-line and an optional sparkline. The owner rejected a bare stat strip on 2026-11-19, so a cell without a sub-line or context does not render in the strip. (5) The identity row above it (bench-surface) holds breadcrumb, record navigation and global actions; a page's primary action moves to the view row.
reference: Accordee, measured (~/.local/state/basalt-accordee/reports/tables.md 2.0 to 2.3, shell.md): toolbar 44 px, border-b, padding 8, gap 16; tab and ghost buttons 28 px, radius 6, 14 px text, 16 px icon; active tab tinted with a 1 px border; counts 12 px muted tabular, the Overdue count red; primary 28 px; KPI strip 96 px, four cells padded 14 by 20, label 12 muted, value 18, sub-line 12 muted, cells split by 1 px borders, a 70 by 24 sparkline at the right on invoices; filter popover 340 wide with 11 px uppercase section labels, 26 px chips, footer "Showing 21 of 50" and Done; a badge with the active count on the trigger. Three tab looks exist there (fill, bordered pill with count, underline with icon and count); take one for the row. Shots: tables/38-invoices-rest.png, tables/01-customers-table-rest.png, tables/03 to 06 (filter popover), records/03-notes-popup-viewmode-menu.png (notes row), tables/83 (phone).
acceptance: A playground list page shows one row: counted tabs left, search, filter with count, layout toggle, view settings and one primary right (shot at 1800 and 390, light and dark)
The row folds at each container tier without wrapping to a second line, except the phone search row
A tab with a count updates when its count changes and binds a ControlHandle
The filter popover shows a live match count and resets
A summary strip cell without context is refused by type or not rendered
out_of_scope: Saved views as tabs and the manage-view panel (bench-manage-view). Board and gallery layouts (bench-view-layouts). The record header.
proof: Before and after frames from `basalt-ui shot` at 1800x1200 and 390x844, light and dark, attached to the PR, and the design reviewer run on them.
